title: Quality Casebook — The Set-up Notice Return Allowance on Payment Arrangements
content:
The set-up notice return allowance that applies when a plan under Payment Arrangements moves to a new payment method follows the plan's returned installment payments in the last six months.

## Governing rule

The kept installment payments are the installment payments received under the plan less those returned.

- A plan with at least 6 kept installment payments and no returned installment payment in the last six months other than the most recent one takes a return allowance of 0 days.
- A plan with at least 6 kept installment payments and at least one other returned installment payment in that period takes 4 days.
- A plan with fewer than 6 kept installment payments takes 2 days.

Returned installment payments are placed in the period by the date the return was received. Periods of six months are counted in whole months back from the handling date. The plan's most recent returned installment payment is never itself an "other" return.

## Casebook entries (hypothetical plans)

**Entry 1.** 12 installment payments received, 1 returned (two weeks ago). Kept: 11. Within the last six months the only return is the most recent one. Allowance: 0 days.

**Entry 2.** 12 received, 3 returned — two weeks ago, three months ago and nine months ago. Kept: 9. Within the last six months there is one return besides the most recent one (the one three months ago). Allowance: 4 days.

**Entry 3.** 12 received, 2 returned — two weeks ago and eight months ago. Kept: 10. The older return lies outside the last six months, so no other return falls in the period. Allowance: 0 days.

**Entry 4.** 7 received, 2 returned. Kept: 5, fewer than 6. Allowance: 2 days, whatever the dates of the returns.

## Table

| Kept installment payments | Other returned installment payments, last 6 months | Return allowance |
|---|---|---|
| 6 or more | None | 0 days |
| 6 or more | One or more | 4 days |
| 5 or fewer | Any | 2 days |
